title: Delete orphaned code to simplify codebase
description: Follow docs/plans/2026-02-27-delete-dead-code.md to remove ~2,400 lines of dead views and services
close_reason: Removed ~2,400 lines of dead code and orphaned files. Kept PlatformCompatibility since it is heavily used by modifiers.

title: [Phase 2] Fix silent error handling (ADR-007 violations)
description:
Multiple views use try? to silently discard errors for user-facing operations, violating ADR-007. Fix all instances to surface errors via alerts:

Silent try? instances:
- MyGardenView.swift:282-285 — gardens/plants fetch
- MyGardenView.swift:522 — AssignGardenSheet.load()
- AddPlantSheet.swift:155 — garden fetch
- MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift:371 — garden fetch
- PlantDatabaseAddToGardenSheet.swift:181 — data fetch
- JournalView.swift:199 — plants fetch
- AddJournalEntryView.swift:278 — plants fetch (also has precedence bug with .filter)
- ReminderManagementView.swift:156,226 — data fetch
- AddReminderView.swift:27 — data fetch

print()-only error handling:
- RemindersListView.swift:145,156 — complete/delete reminder
- MyGardenPlantDetailView.swift:530,543 — care action/delete plant
- AddJournalEntryView.swift:382 — save entry (has TODO comment)
- ReminderRowView.swift:207,225 — complete/reschedule
- MyGardenView.swift:537-538 — save in AssignGardenSheet

Also extract a reusable AlertState struct to consolidate the repeated @State var showAlert/alertTitle/alertMessage pattern across 8+ views.

title: [Phase 1] Simplify BiometricAuthenticationManager to ~30 LOC
description: Replace the 571-line BiometricAuthenticationManager with a simple ~30-line wrapper around LAContext.evaluatePolicy for optional app-lock functionality. No compliance checks, no audit logging, no multi-level fallback.

title: [Phase 3] Externalize TutorialService content to JSON
description: TutorialService.swift (604 LOC) embeds tutorial text and step definitions as inline Swift code. Move content to a JSON resource file. Service becomes a thin loader (~100-150 LOC). Easier to edit content without recompiling.

title: Move Color+Theme.swift to top-level Extensions folder
description: Theme colors are scoped to OnboardingFlow/Extensions/ but the tokens are used app-wide. They should be moved to a more central Extensions/ folder.

title: [Phase 1] Simplify KeychainManager to ~50 LOC
description:
Replace the 1,170-line KeychainManager with a simple ~50-line KeychainService struct that provides:
- save(key: String, data: Data)
- load(key: String) -> Data?
- delete(key: String)

No audit logging, no rate limiting, no batch operations. Just thin wrappers around SecItemAdd/SecItemCopyMatching/SecItemDelete.

Also merge KeychainStorageService.swift (183 LOC) into this simplified version.

Move onboarding preferences (garden type, space size, notification time, gardening goals) from Keychain to @AppStorage/UserDefaults — these are not secrets.

title: Extract Search/Filter and Statistics from DataService
description: The DataService contains Search/Filter methods for plants and a block of read-only Statistics query methods. Extract Search/Filter into PlantRepository and Statistics into a new StatsRepository to further decouple DataService.
close_reason: Extracted Search/Filter logic to PlantRepository and Statistics logic to StatsRepository

title: Extract ModelContainerFactory from DataService
description: Extract schema definition, CloudKit config, and 6-level emergency fallback logic from DataService.swift into a dedicated ModelContainerFactory struct. DataService should call ModelContainerFactory.make() to get a container. See docs/plans/2026-02-27-extract-modelcontainerfactory.md
close_reason: ModelContainerFactory extracted. All 552 tests pass. Committed in 3 atomic commits on feature/data-service-refactor.

title: Extract companionDatabase to a static resource file
description: CompanionPlantingService contains a large companionDatabase dictionary embedded as Swift source. This static data should be moved to a JSON or plist resource file.

title: Fix database initialization crash
description: The extraction of ModelContainerFactory caused a regression where SwiftData fails to attach the CloudKit container to the local SQLite store properly on app launch. Need to rewrite ModelContainerFactory.make() to correctly initialize CloudKit syncing.
close_reason: Fixed ModelConfiguration initialization in ModelContainerFactory.make() so CloudKit connects correctly

title: Move ValidatedTextField from Services to Components
description: ValidatedTextField is currently defined in GrowWiseServices/ValidationService.swift. This is a major layer violation; UI components must reside in GrowWiseFeature/Components.

title: [Phase 1] Delete 11 unnecessary security files
description:
Delete the following security files that serve no purpose in a gardening app (~6,700 LOC):

- AuditLogger.swift (1,119 LOC) - compliance-grade audit trail
- KeyRotationManager.swift (730 LOC) - PCI-DSS key rotation
- MigrationIntegrityService.swift (682 LOC) - migration checksums
- RateLimiter.swift (510 LOC) - token bucket rate limiting
- EncryptionService.swift (503 LOC) - AES-GCM encryption
- TokenManagementService.swift (448 LOC) - JWT token lifecycle
- JWTValidator.swift (439 LOC) - JWT validation
- SecureEnclaveKeyManager.swift (247 LOC) - Secure Enclave keys
- LegacyEncryptionMigrationService.swift (228 LOC) - legacy migration
- AuthenticationProtocols.swift (103 LOC) - auth protocols
- AuthenticationInitializer.swift (28 LOC) - auth bootstrapping

Also delete SecureCredentials.swift (320 LOC) model if nothing else uses it.
Delete all corresponding test files (~30 files).
Remove all imports and references to deleted services from remaining code.

title: [Phase 4] Adopt ContentUnavailableView for empty states
description:
Replace 8+ custom empty state views with iOS 17+ ContentUnavailableView:
- JournalView.swift — empty journal state
- RemindersListView.swift — no reminders state
- MyGardenView.swift:159 — empty garden state
- PlantDatabaseView.swift:144 — no results
- MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift:306-340 — no plants

Use ContentUnavailableView.search(text:) for search-related empty states.

title: [Phase 5] Migrate .onAppear to .task and add cancellation checks
description:
10 instances of .onAppear remain where .task would be safer (auto-cancels on disappear):
- AddPlantSheet.swift:144
- MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift:95
- PlantDatabaseAddToGardenSheet.swift:174
- ReminderManagementView.swift:86
- ReminderSettingsView.swift:62
- PlantReminderCard.swift:87

Also add Task.isCancelled checks in views launching async work to prevent stale updates during rapid navigation.

Fix duplicate .onChange(of: searchText) handlers in JournalView.swift:163,177.

title: Consolidate scattered model enum extensions
description: PlantType has two separate extensions in two different files - iconName in SkillAssessmentView and color in PlantDatabaseView. These should be consolidated into a shared location.

title: Refactor DataService to extract domain-specific repositories
description: DataService is a God object (1,317 lines). Extract domain-specific repos like PlantRepository, ReminderRepository, and JournalRepository. The 8-init-path initialization is a reliability risk.
close_reason: Extracted domain repositories from DataService God-object and migrated view call sites

title: [Phase 4] Decompose 7 largest views into SwiftUI structs
description:
SwiftUI best practice: body should be <30 lines. These 7 views need decomposition:

1. JournalEntryDetailView.swift (841 LOC) — already has good internal structs, but extract to separate files
2. PlantDatabaseView.swift (805 LOC) — extract PlantGridView, PlantFilterBar, PlantSearchResults. Also delete no-op filterAndSortPlants() method (line 266) and its 5 onChange call sites. Fix wateringShorthand data bug: .everyOtherDay maps to '2x/week' but should be '3-4x/week' (line 363)
3. MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift (771 LOC) — already multiple views in one file, split into individual files
4. PlantReminderDetailView.swift (674 LOC) — extract ReminderScheduleSection, ReminderNotificationSection
5. MyGardenPlantDetailView.swift (641 LOC) — extract PlantCareSection, PlantStatsSection, PlantActionsSection
6. AddJournalEntryView.swift (611 LOC) — extract JournalPhotoPickerSection, JournalFormSection. Fix precedence bug at line 278: .filter applies to [] not fetch result
7. SearchBarView.swift (383 LOC) — consider replacing with .searchable() or split into SearchField, SearchSuggestionsList, SearchFilterBar

Also consolidate 4 duplicate filter chip components (FilterChip, GardenChip, JournalFilterChip, FilterTag) into a single reusable component.
Consolidate duplicate plantTypeIcon switch statements in MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift (lines 554 and 719).

title: [Phase 2] Refactor DataService into thin coordinator
description:
DataService.swift (1,201 LOC) is a god object handling CRUD for every domain entity while 6 repositories sit mostly unused. Refactor to commit to the repository pattern:

1. Move all domain CRUD from DataService into repositories (PlantRepository, GardenRepository, ReminderRepository, JournalRepository, UserRepository, StatsRepository)
2. Slim DataService to ~200 LOC: container setup, context provisioning, cache management
3. Remove the 6-level emergency fallback cascade (lines 278-365, ~90 LOC) — replace with single try/catch + error view
4. Remove duplicate modelContext alias (lines 13-18) — keep only mainContext
5. Remove stub methods: getPerformanceMetrics(), clearPerformanceMetrics() (lines 993-1001)
6. Rename misleading exportUserData() to getDataSummary() (lines 903-923)
7. Remove duplicate saveJournalEntry() that just wraps addJournalEntry() (lines 714-740)
8. Fix batchLoadPlantRelationships unused parameter + stray print() (line 933-991)
9. Fix repository computed properties to lazy/stored properties (lines 21-38)
10. Fix cache storing live @Model objects — cache value-type IDs instead (lines 418-431)

title: [Phase 1] Remove PerformanceMonitor
description:
Delete PerformanceMonitor.swift (633 LOC) entirely. Key issues found by review:
- 60 Hz timer creates 60 Task allocations/second on @MainActor (line 284)
- Frame rate measurement is fundamentally broken (Timer can't measure GPU frames, needs CADisplayLink)
- getAvailableMemory() returns wrong value (physicalMemory - appMemory \!= free memory)
- Timer+Task pattern is redundant (line 61-65)

Replace with lightweight os.signpost for development-only profiling if needed (~30 LOC).
Also remove PerformanceMonitor references from DataService and MainAppView.
Remove related test files.

title: [Phase 3] Externalize CompanionPlantingService data to JSON
description: CompanionPlantingService.swift (747 LOC) embeds companion planting relationships (50+ plants) as inline Swift code mixed with service logic. Move the compatibility matrix to a JSON resource file. The service becomes a thin loader (~100 LOC).

title: [Phase 5] Investigate CloudSyncService redundancy
description: CloudSyncService.swift (388 LOC) may be redundant if SwiftData's built-in CloudKit sync via modelConfiguration is handling sync. Investigate whether the app uses SwiftData's native CloudKit integration and whether CloudSyncService can be removed entirely.\n\nAlso check: CloudSyncService.likeCount increment (lines 191-195) has no atomicity — concurrent likes lose updates.

title: [Phase 5] Delete PaywallViewModel and modernize style APIs
description:
1. PaywallViewModel (SubscriptionService.swift:356) — class explicitly named ViewModel violates strict MV architecture (ADR-002). Merge logic into SubscriptionService or rename to a service/manager.

2. Update 71 deprecated style API instances to modern dot-syntax:
   - .cornerRadius(12) → .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
   - RoundedBorderTextFieldStyle() → .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
   - PlainButtonStyle() → .buttonStyle(.plain)
   - InsetGroupedListStyle() → .listStyle(.insetGrouped)
   - SegmentedPickerStyle() → .pickerStyle(.segmented)
   - MenuPickerStyle() → .pickerStyle(.menu)

title: Organize scattered documentation files
description: Move stray .md and txt files from root and base docs/ into logical subdirectories (architecture, product, security, performance, planning).

title: [Phase 3] Externalize PlantDatabaseService data to JSON
description: PlantDatabaseService.swift (948 LOC) embeds 50+ plant encyclopedia entries as inline Swift code. Move the plant data to a JSON resource file in the package bundle. The service becomes a thin loader (~100 LOC) that reads and queries the JSON. Also resolves duplication with GrowWise/Data/Sample/PlantDatabase.swift.

title: Extract ModelContainerFactory from DataService
description: The DataService initialization logic is massively complex. It contains a standard async `createAsync()` builder, a 6-level deeply nested `emergencyStub` fallback waterfall, and 3+ duplicated copies of the `Schema` array. We need to extract this into a `ModelContainerFactory` struct whose sole job is to safely initialize SwiftData and handle all the CloudKit vs. in-memory vs. temp-file recovery mechanics.

title: Delete orphaned files and dead code
description: Scan revealed ~2,400 lines of dead code across 14 unused files. We need to safely remove these unused views, services, and boilerplate files to simplify the project for release.

title: [Phase 5] Fix concurrency issues across services
description:
Concurrency issues found by review:

1. Redundant MainActor.run inside @MainActor methods — remove in:
   - CloudSyncService.swift:65-67, 85-87, 126-128, 167-169, 175-176
   - NotificationService.swift:47-50, 62-65, 71-75, 106-110
2. CloudSyncService defer with Task { @MainActor in } doesn't guarantee ordering (lines 89-91, 129-131) — use direct assignment
3. DataService.createAsync wraps Task.detached in Continuation unnecessarily (lines 146-209) — modernize
4. DataService.fetchPlantDatabase() loops synchronously on @MainActor (lines 508-527) — paginate at UI layer
5. DataService.getGardeningStats() full-table scan on @MainActor (line 844) — use predicate count query
6. ReminderService: batch operations run sequentially (lines 474-490) — use withThrowingTaskGroup
7. LocationService: kCLLocationAccuracyBest overkill for hardiness zones (line 34) — use kCLLocationAccuracyKilometer
8. ReminderService: Keychain for notification booleans (lines 900-946) — move to UserDefaults
9. ReminderService.cancelNotification: fire-and-forget Task (line 988) — make method async
10. JournalEntryDetailView.loadPhotos(): synchronous Data(contentsOf:) on @MainActor (line 258) — use async
11. DateFormatter() created 13 times inside computed properties — cache as static let or use Date.formatted()

title: [Phase 2] Replace NotificationCenter event bus with @Observable patterns
description:
5 instances of NotificationCenter.default.post() used as UIKit-era event bus for cross-view communication:
- MyGardenView.swift:473 — GardenCreated
- PlantDatabaseAddToGardenSheet.swift:221 — PlantCreated
- AddPlantSheet.swift:202 — PlantCreated
- MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift:156 — ShowCreateGardenFromAddPlant
- MyGardenAddPlantViews.swift:454 — PlantCreated

With .onReceive in MyGardenView.swift:86-93 and HomeView.swift:99.

Replace with: sheet onDismiss callbacks, @Binding closures, or leverage DataService's @Observable state for automatic UI updates when data changes.
